reason: Parallel builder sessions were briefed and checked by a coordinator with no written rules. The trace shows the user had to stop a repeated process cut, and a builder's renumbering nearly collided with another branch. One class-level skill for briefing, relaying and checking builder work will serve every such round.

Episode shows the orchestrator briefing Fable builders, routing a verifier FAIL back to a builder, re-verifying a new SHA, and archiving sessions. The trigger should name those moments so this skill is loaded for them.
Four durable briefing rules from this run: propagate verifier-found causes into later briefs, require distinct-id tests, handle vanished sessions, and avoid guard-tripping commands on locked specs.
Verifier-FAIL routing, archive safety and stop-hook noise were all handled ad hoc this run; writing them down keeps the next orchestrator consistent and avoids the repeated stop-hook loop.
The builder's report in this episode gave the SHA and numbers but not the production-only checks or the VERIFY.md split. Writing these into the report template keeps the orchestrator from re-asking.
